_comment: Writable And Executable Directory Probe. Generated from rules/writable_dir_probe.yml by tools/build.py; do not edit.

properties.description: The bot creates an empty dot-file in a directory and runs it with sh, for example `echo > /dev/shm/.b && sh /dev/shm/.b`. It repeats this across /tmp, /var/run, /dev/shm and others to find a directory that is both writable and not mounted noexec, then drops its payload there. A variant creates the file with a bare redirect, makes it executable and runs it directly: `>/tmp/d && chmod 777 /tmp/d && /tmp/d`.

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Writable And Executable Directory Probe from {{src_ip}}
